definitionZh: CSS对齐项目属性为所有直接儿童作为一个群体设定对齐自我值. 在flexbox中,它控制横轴上项目的对齐. 在网格布局中,它控制其网格区域内区块轴上项目的对齐.
sourceDefinition: The CSS align-items property sets the align-self value on all direct children as a group. In flexbox, it controls the alignment of items on the cross axis. In grid layout, it controls the alignment of items on the block axis within their grid areas.
